intro: Hi! So far you've used am, is and are for now. In this lesson you'll talk about the past with was and were: where you were yesterday, how your weekend was, and who wasn't at the meeting. Warm-up: where were you last night? Try 'I was at home.'
teachingNotes: Indonesian doesn't change the verb for time: 'Kemarin saya sakit' uses the same words as today, only 'kemarin' shows the past. English changes the verb: am/is → was, are → were. The #1 error is *'Yesterday I am sick'; whenever the learner uses yesterday, last night, last week or last year, check that the verb is was/were.
was goes with I, he, she, it (one person or thing); were goes with you (one person or many), we and they. Stress *'They was at home' and *'You was late': two names (Rina and Budi) = they → were.
Negatives: was not → wasn't, were not → weren't. Just add not after was/were; never *'not was' or *'didn't was'. In speech was and were are usually weak (/wəz/, /wə/); wasn't and weren't are strong.

Questions: put Was/Were before the subject (Were you at school yesterday?). Indonesian speakers often keep statement order and only raise their voice: *'You were at school yesterday?'. Short answers repeat was/were: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't. A 'Were you…?' question is answered with I: Yes, I was.

Limits: don't teach the past simple of other verbs (went, ate, did), there was/there were, or the past continuous yet. Fixed chunks are fine: I was born in…, How was your weekend? — It was great. No years (not taught yet): use yesterday, last week, last year, on Sunday.

keyPoints.title: was / were in positive sentences
keyPoints.explanation: Past of am/is → was (I, he, she, it). Past of are → were (you, we, they). Use them with past times like yesterday, last night, last week.

examples.en: I was at the office yesterday.
My friends were at the warung last night.

keyPoints.title: Negative: wasn't / weren't
keyPoints.explanation: Add not after was/were: was not → wasn't, were not → weren't. No other word is needed.

examples.en: She wasn't at school on Monday.
examples.id: Dia (perempuan) tidak masuk sekolah hari Senin.

keyPoints.title: Was / Were questions and short answers
keyPoints.explanation: Put was/were before the subject: Was he…? Were you…? Short answers repeat was/were: Yes, he was. / No, I wasn't.

examples.en: Was the film good? — Yes, it was.
Were you tired? — No, I wasn't.

guidedPractice.prompt: Complete with was or were: I ___ tired last night.
Complete with was or were: My friends ___ at the warung at 7 p.m. yesterday.
Make it negative: I was hungry this morning.
expected: i was not hungry this morning

guidedPractice.prompt: Make a question: She was at the bank yesterday.
expected: was she at the bank yesterday

independentPractice.prompt: Translate: Mereka tidak di sekolah hari Jumat.
expected: they weren't at school on friday
they were not at school on friday
on friday they weren't at school
on friday they were not at school

independentPractice.prompt: Answer with a short answer (no): Was it hot in Jakarta yesterday?

assessment.prompt: Complete with was or were: Yesterday Budi ___ at the office all day.

assessment.rubric: Needs 'were'. 'we are in Bandung yesterday' = 30. 'we was' = 40. Missing verb = 20. 'at Bandung' = 80.

assessment.prompt: Make it negative: The shop was open on Sunday.
acceptableAnswers: the shop wasn't open on sunday
the shop was not open on sunday
assessment.rubric: Correct: The shop wasn't / was not open on Sunday. 'weren't' = 40. 'isn't' = 30. 'didn't open' = 30.

assessment.prompt: Make a question: Your parents were at home last night.
acceptableAnswers: were your parents at home last night
assessment.rubric: Correct: Were your parents at home last night? Statement order with a question mark = 20. 'Was your parents' = 40.

assessment.prompt: Listen. Give a short YES answer.
assessment.listen: Was your sister at the wedding on Sunday?
assessment.rubric: Correct: Yes, she was. 'Yes, he was' = 50 (wrong person). 'Yes, I was' = 40. 'Yes' alone = 40. 'Yes, she is' = 30.

assessment.prompt: Give a short NEGATIVE answer: Were they late for the meeting?
assessment.rubric: Correct: No, they weren't. 'No, they wasn't' = 40. 'No, they aren't' = 30. 'No' alone = 40.

blocks.text: For the past, **am** and **is** become **was**, and **are** becomes **were**. So: **I was**, **he/she/it was**, but **you were**, **we were**, **they were**. Remember: **you** takes **were** even for one person.

id.text: Untuk masa lalu, **am** dan **is** menjadi **was**, dan **are** menjadi **were**. Jadi: **I was**, **he/she/it was**, tapi **you were**, **we were**, **they were**. Ingat: **you** memakai **were**, walaupun hanya satu orang.

rows.en: I am at home. → I was at home.
rows.id: Saya di rumah. → Tadi saya di rumah.

rows.en: She is happy. → She was happy.
They are in Bali. → They were in Bali.
rows.id: Mereka di Bali. → Mereka (waktu itu) di Bali.

blocks.text: In Indonesian only the time word changes: *Kemarin saya sakit*. In English the verb changes too: **Yesterday I was sick**, not 'Yesterday I am sick'.

id.text: Dalam bahasa Indonesia hanya kata waktunya yang berubah: *Kemarin saya sakit*. Dalam bahasa Inggris kata kerjanya juga berubah: **Yesterday I was sick**, bukan 'Yesterday I am sick'.

blocks.prompt: My brother ___ in Bali last week.
blocks.explain: My brother = he, and last week is the past → was.

id.explain: My brother = he, dan last week itu masa lalu → was.

blocks.text: These words tell you the sentence is about the past, so use **was/were**: **yesterday** (kemarin), **last night** (tadi malam / semalam), **last week** (minggu lalu), **last year** (tahun lalu), **on Sunday** (hari Minggu kemarin). They can go at the end or at the start: *I was busy yesterday.* / *Yesterday I was busy.*

id.text: Kata-kata ini menunjukkan bahwa kalimatnya tentang masa lalu, jadi pakai **was/were**: **yesterday** (kemarin), **last night** (tadi malam / semalam), **last week** (minggu lalu), **last year** (tahun lalu), **on Sunday** (hari Minggu kemarin). Bisa di akhir atau di awal kalimat: *I was busy yesterday.* / *Yesterday I was busy.*

rows.en: Rina and Budi were at the mall on Sunday.
rows.id: Rina dan Budi di mal hari Minggu kemarin.

rows.en: The weather was hot last week.

blocks.text: Two names or a plural noun = **they** → **were**. 'They was at home' is a very common mistake: say **They were at home**.

id.text: Dua nama atau kata benda jamak = **they** → **were**. 'They was at home' adalah kesalahan yang sangat umum: ucapkan **They were at home**.

options: My cousins was at the beach yesterday.
My cousins were at the beach yesterday.

blocks.text: To say no, put **not** after was/were: **was not → wasn't**, **were not → weren't**. In speech we usually use the short forms.

id.text: Untuk kalimat negatif, taruh **not** setelah was/were: **was not → wasn't**, **were not → weren't**. Dalam percakapan biasanya kita pakai bentuk singkat.

rows.en: I wasn't at work on Friday.
rows.id: Saya tidak masuk kerja hari Jumat.

rows.en: The bus wasn't full this morning.

blocks.text: Just add **not**, nothing else: **She wasn't busy**, not 'She not was busy'.

id.text: Cukup tambahkan **not**, tidak perlu kata lain: **She wasn't busy**, bukan 'She not was busy'.

blocks.prompt: My new shoes ___ cheap. They were very expensive.
blocks.explain: My new shoes = they, so were not → weren't.

id.explain: My new shoes = they, jadi were not → weren't.

blocks.text: To ask a yes/no question, put **was/were before the subject**: She was busy → **Was she busy?** Answer with a short answer that repeats was/were: **Yes, she was.** / **No, she wasn't.**

id.text: Untuk bertanya ya/tidak, taruh **was/were di depan subjek**: She was busy → **Was she busy?** Jawab dengan jawaban singkat yang mengulang was/were: **Yes, she was.** / **No, she wasn't.**

rows.en: Was the film good? — Yes, it was.
Was Pak Hasan at the meeting? — No, he wasn't.
rows.id: Apakah Pak Hasan ikut rapat? — Tidak.

rows.en: Were the students tired? — Yes, they were.

blocks.text: Don't just add a question mark to a sentence: **Were you at school yesterday?**, not 'You were at school yesterday?'. And if someone asks **Were you…?**, answer about yourself with **I**.

id.text: Jangan hanya menambah tanda tanya di akhir kalimat: **Were you at school yesterday?**, bukan 'You were at school yesterday?'. Dan kalau seseorang bertanya **Were you…?**, jawab tentang dirimu dengan **I**.

blocks.prompt: ___ Andi at the futsal game last night?
blocks.explain: Andi = he, and last night is the past → Was.

id.explain: Andi = he, dan last night itu masa lalu → Was.

blocks.text: Monday morning at the office: *How was your weekend? — It was great! I was in Bogor with my family.* At school: *Were you sick yesterday? — Yes, I was.* After a trip: *The hotel was nice, but the food wasn't good.*

id.text: Senin pagi di kantor: *How was your weekend? — It was great! I was in Bogor with my family.* Di sekolah: *Were you sick yesterday? — Yes, I was.* Setelah jalan-jalan: *The hotel was nice, but the food wasn't good.*

suggestedQuestions: Why does English change am/is/are when Indonesian just adds 'kemarin'?
Why is it 'you were' and not 'you was'?
How do I answer 'How was your weekend?'
How do I say 'was' and 'wasn't' naturally?

flashcards.front: I / he / she / it ___ (past of be)

id.intro: Hai! Sejauh ini kamu memakai am, is dan are untuk sekarang. Di pelajaran ini kamu akan bercerita tentang masa lalu dengan was dan were: di mana kamu kemarin, bagaimana akhir pekanmu, dan siapa yang tidak ikut rapat. Pemanasan: tadi malam kamu di mana? Coba jawab 'I was at home.'
suggestedQuestions: Kenapa bahasa Inggris mengubah am/is/are, padahal bahasa Indonesia cukup menambah 'kemarin'?

assessment.pb-1: Lengkapi dengan was atau were: Yesterday Budi ___ at the office all day.
assessment.pb-2: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Inggris: Kemarin kami di Bandung.
assessment.pb-3: Ubah ke kalimat negatif: The shop was open on Sunday.
assessment.pb-4: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Inggris: Kami tidak terlambat kemarin.
assessment.pb-5: Ubah ke kalimat tanya: Your parents were at home last night.
assessment.pb-6: Dengarkan. Beri jawaban singkat YA dalam bahasa Inggris.
assessment.pb-7: Beri jawaban singkat NEGATIF dalam bahasa Inggris: Were they late for the meeting?
